item.description: Online reconnaissance 💬 A Skat-350M UAV technician of the 25th Combined Arms Army of the Zapad Group of Forces shared how his work in Krasny Liman direction helps the command to see the real picture on the battlefield and make the right decisions. 'I operate Skat-350M, it's a great 'bird'. First of all, orientation on the ground. We 'see' 20 kilometres, we transmit the data to the command, and they decide what to do next, send an FPV drone, or work with artillery. We also carry out flights, monitor aviation operations, record the strikes'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🇷🇺 Strengthening strategic partnership Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence of Socialist Republic of Viet
item.description: Strengthening strategic partnership 🇷🇺 🇻🇳 Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence of Socialist Republic of Vietnam General of Army Phan Van Giang. 💬 The Russian Defence Minister noted that the meeting is taking place as part of the State visit to Russia of Secretary General of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam To Lam. 'The contacts between the defence ministries of the two countries have become regular and make an important contribution to the development of strategic relations between Russia and Vietnam. We rely on a joint strategic partnership plan in the military sphere in our work,' said Andrei Belousov. 📆 The Russian Defence Minister also congratulated General of Army Phan Van Giang on the 81st anniversary of the independence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. In turn, General of Army Phan Van Giang thanked Andrei Belousov for the opportunity to meet: 'We know that you have a very busy working schedule, and you have allocated time for this meeting'. 📈 He noted that during the official visit of the Vietnamese delegation in May of this year, specific areas of development of bilateral military and military-technical cooperation were discussed and are currently actively being implemented. 🤝 The talks took place in a constructive manner, the sides discussed current issues of Russian-Vietnamese military and military-technical cooperat
item.content:encoded:

Strengthening
strategic partnership
🇷🇺
🇻🇳
Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence of Socialist Republic of Vietnam General of Army Phan Van Giang.
💬
The Russian Defence Minister noted
that the meeting is taking place as part of the State visit to Russia of Secretary General of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam To Lam.
'The contacts between the defence ministries of the two countries have become regular and make an important contribution to the development of strategic relations between Russia and Vietnam.
We rely on a joint strategic partnership plan in the military sphere in our work,' said Andrei Belousov.
📆
The Russian Defence Minister also congratulated General of Army Phan Van Giang on the 81st anniversary of the independence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
In turn, General of Army Phan Van Giang thanked Andrei Belousov for the opportunity to meet:
'We know that you have a very busy working schedule, and you have allocated time for this meeting'.
📈
He noted that during the official visit of the Vietnamese delegation in May of this year,
specific areas of development of bilateral military and military-technical cooperation were discussed
and are currently actively being implemented.
🤝
The talks took place in a constructive manner,
the sides discussed current issues of Russian-Vietnamese military and military-technical cooperation.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 8 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉

Part 1
)
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades near Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Veseloye, Shilovka, Novotroitskoye, Dobropolye, Novogrishino (Donetsk People's Republic), and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
Up to 380 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade, three air assault brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade close to Mechetnoye, Ivanovka, Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Zelenaya Dibrova, Nikolskoye, Chervony Yar, and Omelnik (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 300 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and five motor vehicles.
💥
Units of the Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Orekhov, Yurkovka, Malokaterinovka, Yulyevka, Novoyakovlevka, and Preobrazhenka in Zaporozhye region.
▪️
More than 45 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and 14 motor vehicles of the AFU were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on
the transport and logistics infrastructure of Ukraine used by the AFU, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 148 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
12 guided aerial bombs, one U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectile, and 713 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊

since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy

▫️
1,776
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,400
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
71,340
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to expand the outer ring of the encircled enemy, as a result, the control over the settlement of Dolgenkoye of Kharkov region has been gained. ▫️ The inner ring continues to shrink, and Berezniki of Kharkov region has been taken under control by Russian troops. 💥 In addition, inside the 'pocket' units of the enemy were hit close to Malaya Volchya, Varvarovka, Buzovo, and Nefedovka in Kharkov region. ▪️ During the day, the AFU losses amounted to up to 30 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two ATVs, and three unmanned aerial vehicle command posts. All attempts of the enemy to break through the encirclement have been thwarted. 🔥 In Sumy region, Russian elements engaged manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Luzhki, Ulanovo, Ivolzhanskoye, and Kiyanitsa (Sumy region). ▪️ In total, up to 180 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and eight motor vehicles were neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces. 📍 The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions. item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29276

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to expand the outer ring of the encircled enemy, as a result, the control over the settlement of Dolgenkoye of Kharkov region has been gained.
▫️
The inner ring continues to shrink, and
Berezniki of Kharkov region has been taken under control by Russian troops.
💥
In addition,
inside the 'pocket' units of the enemy were hit
close to Malaya Volchya, Varvarovka, Buzovo, and Nefedovka in Kharkov region.
▪️
During the day, the AFU losses amounted to up to 30 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two ATVs, and three unmanned aerial vehicle command posts. All attempts of the enemy to break through the encirclement have been thwarted.
🔥
In Sumy region, Russian elements engaged
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Luzhki, Ulanovo, Ivolzhanskoye, and Kiyanitsa (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, up to 180 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and eight motor vehicles were neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade near Osinovo, Petrovka, Kovalevka, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), Glubokaya Makatikha, Krymki, Bogorodichnoye, Sidorovo, and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 190 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted fire damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade, and an assault regiment of the AFU near Slavyansk, Cherevkovka, Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Nikanorovka, Nikolayevka, and Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 190 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 17 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
